                                                                           LIABILITY ON USED EQUIPMENT OR MACHINERY

    For claim purposes, all used machinery or equipment will be considered released to a value not exceeding $5.00 per pound. This applies on
    commodities which are used, old, scrap or having value only for reclamation, salvage, reconditioning or reconstruction. Used items which have been
    reconditioned and not further used prior to shipment will not be considered used equipment.
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

                                                                        ALTERNATE APPLICATION OF RATES AND CHARGES

    In no case shall the charge for any shipment from and to the same points, via the same route or movement, be greater than the charges for a greater
    quantity of same commodity, subject to the same packing provisions, at the rate and weight applicable to such greater quantity of freight.

    EXAMPLE:
    In those instances where a shipment weighs 950 lbs., the applicable 500 pound LTL class rate with the applicable LTL discount (if any), will
    alternate with the 1,000 lb. LTL class rate with the applicable LTL discount (if any). That calculation which produces the lower charge will take
    precedence.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


                                                                      CUBIC CAPACITY AND DENSITY – MINIMUM CHARGE

    This applies when a shipment of class 50 through 250 occupies 750 cubic feet or more, with an actual density of less than 4 pounds per cubic foot.
    For the purpose of determining cubic feet, any packaged shipping unit such as below will be considered 84 inches in height if the actual height is less
    than 84 inches:
             Pallets, skids or cartons banded or shrink wrapped into a single unit which are pyramided, rounded, or topped off; or
             Units which have an irregular shape on top (i.e. machines, etc.); or
             Units which are marked with instruction that no other freight is to be loaded on top.

    Minimum shipment charge – Multiply total cubic feet, or portion thereof, by 8 lbs., then multiply the resultant weight by the class 100 rate using rates
    contained herein the agreement with applicable discount If the otherwise applicable charge is greater than the calculation in this item, the otherwise
    applicable charge will apply.

    When cubic capacity/minimum density rule is applied the following documentation must be provided: Weight and Inspection inclusive of cube and
    density calculation per pallet and pictures

                                                         FUEL SURCHARGE/REBATE

            Fuel prices will be reviewed by Shipper no later than Tuesday 12:00 p.m. of each week by calling the Department of Energy
            (DOE) at (202) 586-6966 and entering #1, or via the DOE website: https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/
                Surcharges will be based on the national diesel fuel average as indicated by the DOE and effective on Monday of each week
                 (Monday to Sunday period). Surcharge will apply to all loads picked up during that Monday to Sunday period.
                Surcharges will become effective after an increase in the national diesel fuel average over ($1.40)
                Fuel average fractions as indicated by the DOE of less than one-half cent will be rounded down, while fractions of one-half
                 cent or more will be rounded up.
                Surcharge amount must be indicated as a separate line item on each freight invoice submitted to Shipper for payment.
                Surcharge will apply on applicable net linehaul freight charges, exclusive of accessorial freight charges.
                No other addendum or fuel surcharge sliding scale will be accepted by Shipper.
                Surcharge break points will be reviewed annually utilizing DOE National Diesel Fuel Statistics for the preceding two years.
                For each five-cent increment (or portion thereof), over $6.199, increase the fuel surcharge an additional 0.3%.

                                                             SCHEDULE B-1
                                                         EXCLUSIVE USE SERVICE

            PURPOSE:

            This Schedule shall serve as an agreement between LTL Carrier and Home Depot to cover situations where the carrier delivers a
            full truckload, as defined herein, to a Home Depot location due to Home Depot’s transportation system assigning such load to
            Carrier (“Exclusive Use Service”).

            LOCATIONS:

            The Home Depot Locations

            PROCESS AND PRICING:

            In the event Carrier provides Exclusive Use Service to Home Depot, Carrier shall promptly notify Home Depot of such full
            truckload and include the following documents: BOL, Exclusive Use form and pictures of freight. These details should be
            submitted via a ticket through Supplier Hub at supplierhub.homedepot.com. Select Transportation > LTL > Accessorial
            Approval. Home Depot will then review and approve that a full truckload was indeed delivered, using the conditions below and
            the required details received from the Carrier. Home Depot will then provide to Carrier the rate for such movement based on the
            Home Depot TL Matrix Rate average from the origin zip code to destination zip code. The Home Depot TL Matrix Rates will be
            reviewed every 90 days to ensure any market condition fluctuation is accounted for fairly, and these rates will be provided to you
            for your reference.

            The same details that have been provided by the Carrier will be investigated further to determine why the TL shipment was
            tendered to an LTL carrier to make corrections and decrease the possibility of this happening again.

            Full Truckload Shipments are defined as follows:

            Any shipment to a single Home Depot destination which occupies GREATER THAN 24 linear feet OR more of trailer space or
            meets the below criteria:


                                                  Freight Class Range                     Greater than
                                                 50                92.5                   20,000 lbs.
                                                100                125                    15,000 lbs.
                                                150                200                    10,000 lbs.
                                                250                500                     5,000 lbs.

                                        hindering/blocking access of the driveway or garage of the customer. The customer should be
                                        contacted to schedule a 4-hour delivery window appointment. A pre-call must be performed by the
                                        Provider the day prior as well as a delivery pre-call within thirty (30) minutes of delivery arrival.
                                        An individual, 18 years or older, must be present at the time of delivery to provide a signature.
                                       Carrier must notify the Customer of previously scheduled changes.
                                       Carrier must provide records of pre-call activities (day prior and day of) if inquired by The Home
                                        Depot associates.
                   Delivery Requirements:
                         o Carrier is expected to resource labor and provide tools/equipment (i.e. lift gates and pallet jacks) to safely
                             deliver all customer orders:
                                       Carriers will provide deliveries that use 28’, 48’ and 53’ foot straight (tractor) truck(s) in providing
                                        delivery service to The Home Depot customers.
                                       Lift-gates must be fully operational with a minimum threshold of 2,500 pounds, 60” x 80” deck
                                        with a 10-inch retention ramp.
                                       Truck door opening heights must be able to accommodate freight heights up to 96” without tilting
                                        freight.
                                       Carrier may be required to arrange for the delivery of oversized items that may require additional
                                        labor / helper(s).
                                       Customer deliveries must be delivered in full based on the items received off the BOL.
                                       Customer deliveries may not be split into multiple day delivery without permission from The Home
                                        Depot.
                                       Reinforce the need to maintain an order to a trailer and never split a customer order with multiple
                                        pallets between two trailers. Home Depot Unbundled LTL Playbook.
                         o All vehicles must be in good order or repair, clean inside and out, and free of leaks that could results in
                             damaging of THD Customer’s property.

                             occur during Customer time windows.
                         o Carrier will leave the Customer with necessary paperwork such as proof of delivery, and any exceptions
                             related documentation.

                                    All overages, shortages, and/or damages (“OS&Ds”) should be communicated (with photo proof for
                                     damaged product) to Home Depot within twenty-four (24) hours of product receipt. OS&D product
                                     must be retained until Home Depot provides a disposition.
                         o Convey Case Management – Exception Use Cases
                                    Minor Address Change: Used when the provided address is incorrect due to a spelling error or
                                     transposed numbers.
                                    Major Address Change: Used when the Customer requests delivery to a new address.
                                    Requires Special Equipment: Used when the Carrier cannot safely deliver a shipment and all
                                     alternate delivery methods have been exhausted.
                                    Cannot Schedule: Used when the Carrier is unable to contact the Customer, at the third attempt,
                                     using the Customers provided contact information on ASN and/or BOL.
                                    Consignee Refused: Used when the Customer refuses a delivery due to but not limited to a
                                     cancellation and unrelated to product damage.
                                    OS&D Short: Used when one or more pieces are missing from a shipment when received.
                                    Request Paperwork: Used when the BOL is not received during handoff, the item is not listed on the
                                     BOL and/or ASN and/or the item has no label.
                                    Service Approval: Used when billing party is listed incorrectly on the BOL, seeking approval for lift
                                     gate fee, seeking approval for redelivery fee, seeking approval for storage fee when the Customer
                                     requests items to be held and/or the Customer requests a service level upgrade to their delivery.
                                    Lost: Used when items are confirmed as received but cannot be located for delivery to the Customer
                                     and/or the Carrier is unable to receive inbound product due to mishap.
                                    OS&D Damage: Used when product is received with damage, product is damaged at the Carrier’s

                    Copy of the bill of lading
                    Consignee name and address

                    Eight digit transfer number or reference number
                    Consignee – THD store number and address
                    Shipper – THD store number and address
                    All charges must be separated and labeled
                    Proof of delivery (preferably a keyrec label)

            Third Party (THD is neither the shipper nor consignee)
                   Unique pro number (unless corrected bill or rebill)
                   Purchase order number or reference number
                   All charges must be separated and labeled
                   Bill of lading stating THD as the third party bill to
                   Store or Store Support Center location incurring the charges

            Detention Charges
                    Shipper name and address
                    Consignee name and address (THD/DC store number if applicable)

                    Arrival time and Departure time
                    Qualcomm stamp or
                    Signature from consignee showing agreement to times noted

            Drop Trailers
                   Shipper name and address
                   Consignee name and address (THD/DC/Store number if applicable)
                   Document showing date and time of drop
                   Document showing unload date and time

                                              SCHEDULE A-2
                                       GUARANTEED DELIVERY SERVICE

         The terms of this Schedule A-2 (“Schedule”) shall only apply to Guaranteed Delivery Service as described
         herein.


         LOCATIONS
         The Home Depot locations


         PRICING
         This Schedule will apply on the following MC, LTL, and TL shipments which Carrier originates and serves direct.
         Weekend deliveries are not available for Guaranteed Delivery Service.

         INBOUND/OUTBOUND/THIRD PARTY

         Guaranteed Delivery Before 3:30 PM:

                 Rated at:                         An additional 30% applies to the net linehaul revenue exclusive of any
                                                   accessorial charges, as derived from Pricing Appendices contained
                                                   herein.

                 Minimum Charge:                   $25.00


         Guaranteed Delivery Before Noon:

                 Rated at:                         An additional 45% applies to the net linehaul revenue exclusive of any
                                                   accessorial charges, as derived from Pricing Appendices contained
                                                   herein.

                 Minimum Charge:                   $75.00


         Guaranteed Delivery Before 9:00 AM:

                 Rated at:                         An additional 50% applies to the net linehaul revenue exclusive of any
                                                   accessorial charges, as derived from Pricing Appendices contained
                                                   herein.

                 Minimum Charge:                   $90.00


         DEFINITION – GUARANTEED DELIVERY SERVICE
         Shipments will be guaranteed to be delivered complete and on-time at the Carrier standard speed service
         standards before 3:30 PM local time, before 12:00 PM (noon) local time, or before 9:00 AM local time depending
         on the service requested, exclusive of Saturdays, Sundays, and all national, state, and local holidays.




                                                              Page 1 of 3
DocuSign Envelope ID: A33B14F2-93E7-497F-97E9-CA7B5F5C19F8




         Schedule A-2, cont’d
         The Home Depot



         NON APPLICATION
         This Schedule will not apply to:

         A)      Prohibited or Restricted Articles; any pieces over 15 feet in length; or any shipment requiring Protective
                 Service

         B)      Delivery locations of convention or exposition centers; carnivals, fairs, or traveling shows; private
                 residences; self-storage warehouses; grocery warehouses; or mines or mining operations

         C)      Deliveries requiring an appointment; Collect on Delivery (COD) shipments; Order notify shipments; or
                 any request declined by the Carrier prior to departure from origin city


         SERVICE REQUIREMENT/CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES

         A)      The Customer must contact a Carrier service center via phone no later than 3:00 PM local time on the
                 day of pickup to request the pickup of a Guaranteed Delivery shipment, advising the Carrier that the
                 pickup request involves such a shipment. Any special services or equipment requirements must be
                 requested at this time and either approved or declined by a management representative of the origin
                 Carrier. The freight must be ready for pickup no later than 5:00 PM local time that Business Day.

         B)      Prior to shipments, the customer (or pickup driver) must affix a special “Guaranteed Delivery” B/L sticker
                 to the bill of lading. In lieu of the label, customer may write “GUARANTEED – 3:30 PM”,
                 “GUARANTEED – NOON”, or “GUARANTEED – 9:00 AM”, the quote number obtained by a Carrier
                 company representative, and all other required information on all copies of the bill of lading, including
                 the authorized signature of Customer, except that the validity of such requests shall be subject to
                 Carrier’s sole determination.

         C)      Collect shipments will be accepted provided the Shipper does not execute Section 7 of the bill of lading.

         D)      Special services and equipment requirements requested of and approved by the Carrier must be clearly
                 written on the bill of lading.


         SERVICE GUARANTEE AND LIABILITY

         The guarantee does not apply to shipments which are delayed due to caused beyond Carrier’s control including,
         but not limited to, the following: the unavailability or refusal of person to accept delivery of the shipments,
         delays caused by the consignee, acts of God, public authorities acting with actual or apparent authority on the
         premises, act or admissions of customs or similar authorities, riot, strikes, or other labor disputes, civil
         commotion, disruptions in air or ground transportation networks, such as weather phenomena, and natural
         disasters.

         Charges for Guaranteed Delivery shipments that are delayed by Force Majeure will be billed at normal pricing
         published for the payer.

         SERVICE GUARANTEE AND LIABILITY, cont’d

         An attempted delivery shall constitute a delivery and shall satisfy Carrier’s obligations for services. In the case
         of refusal, our driver will attempt to get the refusing party’s signature, date, time, and reason for refusal or
         inability to deliver.

         Attempted delivery to a wrong address due to incorrect or incomplete Consignee information provided by the
         Shipper shall constitute a delivery and shall satisfy Carrier’s obligations for services. The resulting required
         changes to the bill of lading will be assessed at the normal rate.

         Carrier will notify customer in the case of delay (when known prior to delivery deadline.

         If Carrier provides Guaranteed Delivery Service under this Agreement, the following liability limitations will apply
         in respect to the failure to timely provide such service:

         Carrier’s maximum liability for failure (short delivery or non-delivery on the day promised within the time limited
         specified herein) to deliver any shipments within the agreed-upon deadline will not exceed 100% of applicable
         freight charges (not including value-added accessorial charges) for such shipment. An adjusted invoice will be
         sent, no claim will be required. Carrier will not be liable for any incidental, consequential, or special damages,
         commercial loss of any kind (including loss of business or profits), or loss, damage, or expense directly, or
         indirectly arising from failure to provide the service provided in this Schedule whether or not Carrier has been
         advised of the possibility of such damage or loss.
